title: What is a conditional? Grammar: Conditionals with Georgie
speaker: BBC Learning English
zh: 【BBC Learning English】什麼是條件句？語法：Georgie 的條件句（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: So if it rains, I'll probably just stay inside and watch a film.
cues.en: So if it rains, I'll probably just stay inside and watch a film.
cues.zh: 所以如果下雨，我可能會待在家裡看電影。

cues.text: Hello and welcome to Conditionals with Georgie - that's me!
cues.en: Hello and welcome to Conditionals with Georgie - that's me!
cues.zh: 您好，歡迎來到 Georgie 的條件句 - 這就是我！

cues.text: Conditionals can be tricky.
cues.en: Conditionals can be tricky.
cues.zh: 條件句可能很棘手。

cues.text: We sometimes think of them like they're mathematical equations:
cues.en: We sometimes think of them like they're mathematical equations:
cues.zh: 我們有時會將它們視為數學方程式：

cues.text: use this structure plus this structure, in this situation,
cues.en: use this structure plus this structure, in this situation,
cues.zh: 使用這個結構加上這個結構，在這種情況下，

cues.text: but not this situation.
cues.en: but not this situation.
cues.zh: 但不是這種情況。

cues.text: But sometimes, it's best to just relax, get your head out of the books,
cues.en: But sometimes, it's best to just relax, get your head out of the books,
cues.zh: 但有時候，最好放鬆一下，把注意力從書本上移開，

cues.text: and hear how they're used in real life.
cues.en: and hear how they're used in real life.
cues.zh: 並聽聽它們在現實生活中如何使用。

cues.text: So, what is a conditional?
cues.en: So, what is a conditional?
cues.zh: 那麼，什麼是條件式呢？

cues.text: Conditionals have two parts - the condition or a situation,
cues.en: Conditionals have two parts - the condition or a situation,
cues.zh: 條件句有兩個部分－條件或情況，

cues.text: and the possible consequences or results of that situation.
cues.en: and the possible consequences or results of that situation.
cues.zh: 以及該情況可能產生的後果或結果。

cues.text: If this happens, this happens.
cues.en: If this happens, this happens.
cues.zh: 如果發生這種情況，就會發生這種情況。

cues.text: Look: Usually, when I finish work, I play guitar.
cues.en: Look: Usually, when I finish work, I play guitar.
cues.zh: 看：通常，當我完成工作時，我會彈吉他。

cues.text: So, if I don't do that, then I kind of feel a bit stressed out, maybe.
cues.en: So, if I don't do that, then I kind of feel a bit stressed out, maybe.
cues.zh: 所以，如果我不這樣做，那麼我可能會感到有點壓力。

cues.text: Now, there are different types of conditionals that express different things.
cues.en: Now, there are different types of conditionals that express different things.
cues.zh: 現在，有不同型別的條件語句表達不同的事物。

cues.text: The type in the first example expresses things that are generally true or facts.
cues.en: The type in the first example expresses things that are generally true or facts.
cues.zh: 第一個範例中的型別表達了通常真實的事物或事實。

cues.text: If George doesn't play the guitar, he usually feels stressed out, in general.
cues.en: If George doesn't play the guitar, he usually feels stressed out, in general.
cues.zh: 一般來說，如果喬治不彈吉他，他通常會感到壓力很大。

cues.text: But what else can you do with conditionals?
cues.en: But what else can you do with conditionals?
cues.zh: 但是條件語句還能做什麼呢？

cues.text: Well, you can use conditionals to express a likely future situation and
cues.en: Well, you can use conditionals to express a likely future situation and
cues.zh: 嗯，你可以使用條件句來表達未來可能的情況

cues.text: the possible consequences of that.
cues.en: the possible consequences of that.
cues.zh: 可能產生的後果。

cues.text: If all the Tubes are cancelled, then I will cry, and get three buses home.
cues.en: If all the Tubes are cancelled, then I will cry, and get three buses home.
cues.zh: 如果所有地鐵都取消了，我會哭，然後搭三班公車回家。

cues.text: If all the tubes - that's underground trains - are cancelled,
cues.en: If all the tubes - that's underground trains - are cancelled,
cues.zh: 如果所有的地鐵——也就是地鐵——都被取消，

cues.text: which is a likely situation in London, Andrew will cry,
cues.en: which is a likely situation in London, Andrew will cry,
cues.zh: 這在倫敦很可能發生，安德魯會哭，

cues.text: but only if the tubes are cancelled.
cues.en: but only if the tubes are cancelled.
cues.zh: 但前提是這些管道被取消。

cues.text: It depends on that condition.
cues.en: It depends on that condition.
cues.zh: 這取決於那個條件。

cues.text: You can talk about situations that are unlikely to happen in the future -
cues.en: You can talk about situations that are unlikely to happen in the future -
cues.zh: 你可以談論未來不太可能發生的情況——

cues.text: hypothetical scenarios - and the consequences of that.
cues.en: hypothetical scenarios - and the consequences of that.
cues.zh: 假設的場景 - 以及其後果。

cues.text: If I won a million pounds, I'd probably go travelling all round the world.
cues.en: If I won a million pounds, I'd probably go travelling all round the world.
cues.zh: 如果我贏得一百萬英鎊，我可能會環遊世界。

cues.text: Now, it's unlikely Pippa will win a million pounds, but she's kind of imagining and dreaming about what she could do
cues.en: Now, it's unlikely Pippa will win a million pounds, but she's kind of imagining and dreaming about what she could do
cues.zh: 現在，皮帕不太可能贏得一百萬英鎊，但她有點想像和夢想她能做什麼

cues.text: if she won a million pounds.
cues.en: if she won a million pounds.
cues.zh: 如果她贏得一百萬英鎊。

cues.text: Why weren't you at the meeting?
cues.en: Why weren't you at the meeting?
cues.zh: 為什麼沒有參加會議？

cues.text: Because you didn't tell me about it.
cues.en: Because you didn't tell me about it.
cues.zh: 因為你沒有告訴我這件事。

cues.text: If you'd told me about it, I would have been there.
cues.en: If you'd told me about it, I would have been there.
cues.zh: 如果你告訴我這件事，我就會在那裡。

cues.text: You can use conditionals for past situations too.
cues.en: You can use conditionals for past situations too.
cues.zh: 您也可以對過去的情況使用條件句。

cues.text: So these are things that have already happened, so you can't change them,
cues.en: So these are things that have already happened, so you can't change them,
cues.zh: 所以這些都是已經發生的事情，所以你無法改變它們，

cues.text: but you're imagining alternative situations and their results.
cues.en: but you're imagining alternative situations and their results.
cues.zh: 但你正在想像其他情況及其結果。

cues.text: So I've given you a quick overview of the main conditionals.
cues.en: So I've given you a quick overview of the main conditionals.
cues.zh: 我已經向您快速概述了主要條件。

cues.text: And, now later in the series, we'll look at them in more detail,
cues.en: And, now later in the series, we'll look at them in more detail,
cues.zh: 現在，在本系列的後面部分，我們將更詳細地瞭解它們，

cues.text: not forgetting about the mixed conditionals too.
cues.en: not forgetting about the mixed conditionals too.
cues.zh: 不要忘記混合條件。

cues.text: Don't forget to check out our website and download the free worksheet to help you practise. See you next time!
cues.en: Don't forget to check out our website and download the free worksheet to help you practise. See you next time!
cues.zh: 不要忘記檢視我們的網站並下載免費的工作表來幫助您練習。下次見！
